title: [GMCP 203.018.02] Production path: Client connection runtime, caching, retries, and concurrency
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-018-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: The client runtime pools only security-equivalent connections, honors ttlMs and cacheScope, invalidates on notifications, applies deadline and cancellation budgets, retries only safe operations with jitter and circuit breaking, and enforces per-server plus global concurrency and memory bounds. Reconnect, half-open, duplicate-response, slowloris, crash-loop and thundering-herd tests prove deterministic recovery without duplicate side effects. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
